page_title: ROM 1-2 ACM | AS Roma v AC Milan 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Noah Okafor (AC Milan) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+5' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.

90+2' 1 - 2 GOAL 1:2! Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
89' Riccardo Pagano (AS Roma) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
88' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
85' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
84' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
83' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

83' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.

81' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle after Noah Okafor (AC Milan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
79' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Pagano (AS Roma) replacing Gianluca Mancini.
79' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
78' A cross from Noah Okafor (AC Milan) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
76' Substitution. Rafael Leao will be replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
76' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
74' Dangerous play by Edoardo Bove (AS Roma). Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) is coming onto the pitch as Leandro Paredes cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy will be replaced by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma).
70' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Zeki Celik will be replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma).
70' It is time for a substitution. Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) is on for Olivier Giroud.
70' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Mike Maignan.
70' The game has begun to heat up. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
69' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
65' A substitution has been made. Ruben Loftus-Cheek is replaced by Pierre Kalulu (AC Milan).
64' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
63' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
61' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
59' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
56' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
55' 0:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
52' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

52' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
48' 0 - 2 What a GOAL! The lofted pass into the box is expertly and acrobatically dispatched into the net by Rafael Leao (AC Milan). 0:2.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle as Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
43' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
40' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
37' 0:3 – the corner kicks stats.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
31' Problems for Jose Mourinho as Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lorenzo Pellegrini replaces him.
30' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' A nice individual effort by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
27' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
25' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
23' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) controls the ball after receiving a cross, but he slices his shot well wide of the left post.
23' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
22' It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.

22' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) thinks he has scored after reacting fastest to a lofted ball into the box, but Rui Patricio pulls a rabbit out of the hat and makes a stunning save to thwart him for close range. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' The ratio of the ball possession is 26:74.
19' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
17' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
16' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
15' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
13' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) commits a foul and Antonio Rapuano immediately signals a free kick.
11' A rebound sits up nicely for Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the left post and out for a goal kick.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Rui Patricio.
9' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
8' The AC Milan players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
7' There's a break in play and referee Antonio Rapuano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by AC Milan using VAR. This could be interesting!
6' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
6' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. AC Milan earn a corner.
3' AS Roma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is the one to supervise the game today.
